questions.prompt: What does @submit.prevent="save" do on a form?

options.text: Prevents the form from ever submitting
Calls event.preventDefault() and then runs save, stopping the default page reload

questions.explanation: The .prevent modifier calls event.preventDefault() for you, so the browser doesn't reload the page, and then your save handler runs.

questions.prompt: What is the difference between @click="save" and @click="save()"?

options.text: @click="save" uses the function as the handler; @click="save()" calls it immediately at render

questions.explanation: @click="save" passes the function reference; @click="save()" invokes save during render (and uses its return value), which is usually a mistake unless you intend to pass arguments.

questions.prompt: To collect several checkboxes into one value, what should you bind them to with v-model?
questions.explanation: Bind multiple checkboxes to the same array with v-model; each checked box's value is added to the array. A single checkbox bound to a boolean is for on/off.

questions.prompt: The v-model modifier that trims leading and trailing whitespace is .______ (one word).
questions.explanation: v-model.trim removes surrounding whitespace from the bound value; .number casts to a number and .lazy syncs on change.

questions.prompt: v-model on a text input is essentially shorthand for what?

options.text: Binding :value and updating state on the input event

questions.explanation: For a text input, v-model binds :value to the state and listens for the input event to write changes back — two-way binding.

questions.prompt: Which are valid event modifiers in Vue? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: .prevent, .stop, and key modifiers like .enter are real. There is no .reload modifier.
